title: DAEE Field Witness (top-level key contract)
description: Published top-level shape of the machine-readable field_witness payload, schema_version field-witness-v1. This pins the TOP-LEVEL key contract only (required + allowed-optional keys); deep per-key validation stays in tools/check_ir_instance_integrity.py, whose FIELD_WITNESS_KEYS / FIELD_WITNESS_OPTIONAL_KEYS sets are asserted equal to this schema's required / optional properties by tools/check_field_witness_binding.py (single source, assert-equality). This is a structural key contract only: it is NOT a semantic-faithfulness, interlocutor-uptake, provenance, or release claim, and it does not certify that a conforming field_witness is correct or freshly generated.
